title: Journey Through Middle-earth — S4 review stills
notes: The curated S4 stills for the user's review (tools/capture/review.ts composes review/s4/ from a qa run of the s4-review set). Order follows the film: the map, the prologue (Erebor, Lake-town), then Frodo's road from the Shire to Mount Doom. `look` = what to look at; `s3Issue` = the S3 critic issue (renders/qa/20261001-174844/critic-s3-final.json) the still answers. Time of day and camera distance are read from the shot data by the tool. Render: pnpm qa --set s4-review --quality final --w 1920 --h 1080 --spp 12 --batch 6 --label s4-review.

stills.title: The map — day
stills.look: The floating slab reads as a crisp physical model: coastlines, ranges, rivers and forests legible at a glance; the film grade stays neutral at this distance.
stills.s3Issue: Wide shots must stay clear and readable (S2/S3 decision) while the regional grades carry the mood.

stills.title: The map — golden hour
stills.look: Low warm light rakes the relief; the shadows of the Misty and White Mountains, warm highlights against cool shadows.
stills.s3Issue: Flat, map-like light (the C1 critics' 'crisp but flat').

stills.title: The map — night
stills.look: Moonlit land with clean dark blacks (no milky lift), settlement lights as warm pins, Mordor's fires under the pall.
stills.s3Issue: Night frames had lifted, milky blacks; Mordor read faint at night.

stills.title: The map — from above
stills.look: Near-orthographic geography check: north up, every region in its place, sea without banding.
stills.s3Issue: Geography and readability reference (no film-look issue).

stills.title: Erebor and the Long Lake
stills.look: Regional depth: aerial perspective over Wilderland, the Lonely Mountain alone on the plain, the Long Lake reading as a lake.
stills.s3Issue: Lake-town's Long Lake read as a river in places; no aerial haze beyond ~40 km.

stills.title: Erebor — the Lonely Mountain
stills.look: Broken snowfields on rock instead of an icing cap, the banner cloud, the gate at the foot of the massif, the warm low sun.
stills.s3Issue: Erebor read as a papier-mâché cone with an icing-sugar snowcap on a featureless plain.

stills.title: Lake-town — afternoon
stills.look: Cold blue-grey lake haze, the town on its stilts, the film grade's cool shadows and warm highlights.
stills.s3Issue: Untextured beige gable boxes on bright water in front of a blank olive hillside; no cold lake haze.

stills.title: Lake-town — night
stills.look: Window lights on the water, deep blacks, the town's silhouette against the moonlit lake.
stills.s3Issue: No window lights; Lake-town's hero was dark at dusk.

stills.title: The Shire
stills.look: Hedgerow patchwork and copses at believable scale; greens lush rather than lime.
stills.s3Issue: Lime / yellow-green greens at full saturation; lollipop trees at 10–20× real size.

stills.title: Hobbiton — late afternoon
stills.look: The Hill and the smials sharp, the fields beyond a touch soft (f/11); greens shifted from lime toward a lusher green; golden highlights, cool-green shadows.
stills.s3Issue: Model-railway read: smooth one-colour mound, broccoli trees, mustard-olive clay grass.

stills.title: Hobbiton — night
stills.look: Moonlit Hill with the round windows lit, clean blacks, no milky haze.
stills.s3Issue: Night frames had lifted, milky blacks.

stills.title: Rivendell — late October
stills.look: Amber highlights and a soft Pro-Mist bloom in the gorge, valley mist, the falls, the Last Homely House on its spur.
stills.s3Issue: No falls, spray or mist; dry faceted cliffs; cotton-wool autumn trees.

stills.title: Rivendell — night
stills.look: The house's lamps against the dark gorge, halation round the lights, mist in the valley.
stills.s3Issue: Emission never lit its surroundings; no veiled depth.

stills.title: The Doors of Durin
stills.look: Ithildin light spilling onto the rock and reflected in the black pool, the hollies, the mist.
stills.s3Issue: Neon line-icon door on a flat panel; a dead black lake with no reflection of the glow; puck hollies.

stills.title: Lothlórien — dusk
stills.look: The golden wood's lights and the soft luminous grade, mallorn canopy instead of blobs.
stills.s3Issue: Lollipop / broccoli crowns; emission that never lights the canopy.

stills.title: The Argonath
stills.look: The Kings sharp at f/4, the far peaks and Tol Brandir softened a touch; haze behind the statues for scale.
stills.s3Issue: Clear gradient sky and no haze — the Kings read as tabletop figurines.

stills.title: Rauros
stills.look: The falls and their spray, Tol Brandir, the haze over Nen Hithoel.
stills.s3Issue: No waterfalls, spray or plumes anywhere in the world.

stills.title: The Anduin and Gondor
stills.look: Aerial perspective over Ithilien, Doom glowing under the pall in the distance, cool steel shadows and warm highlights.
stills.s3Issue: Crisp but flat relief map with saturated greens and no depth haze.

stills.title: Minas Tirith — dawn
stills.look: Early sun raking the tiers, cool grey stone against the mountain, steel-blue shadows (Gondor's split-tone).
stills.s3Issue: Uniform white plaster city under flat noon light against a warm brown cliff.

stills.title: Minas Tirith — the beacons lit
stills.look: The beacon fire and its glow on the rock, the city's lights, deep night blacks.
stills.s3Issue: Emission never lit rock; no beacon fires.

stills.title: Minas Morgul — the beam
stills.look: The beam from the tower, green spill washing the cliffs and the vale's fog instead of mint paint, charcoal rock.
stills.s3Issue: Flat pale-mint emissive paint like glow-in-the-dark plastic; no falloff, no green haze.

stills.title: The Black Gate
stills.look: Ash overcast, charcoal rock and gate with a cold steel cast, red only in the glow beyond.
stills.s3Issue: Saturated royal-blue sky over a sand floor; then (C1) a muddy mid-grey with no blacks.

stills.title: Mordor
stills.look: The pall over the plateau, charcoal ground, red only near Doom.
stills.s3Issue: Clear saturated skies over Mordor; chocolate sand dunes.

stills.title: Mount Doom
stills.look: The plume and the pall lit red from below, broken basalt and cinder, lava light on the rock.
stills.s3Issue: No smoke plume or ash pall; clean blue twilight sky; smooth chocolate dunes.

knownIssues: The S3 stills (before) are 1600×900 review-tier renders at spp 4; the S4 stills are final tier — the before/after sheets rescale both to one height.

Depth of field is only on the hero stills whose bookmark carries an f-stop (deep focus f/22 otherwise) and only at spp >= 8; it is deliberately very subtle (blur at infinity <= 0.3 % of the frame height).
Film grain is part of the final tier: the stills carry ≈ 1 % luminance grain in the mid-tones (deterministic per film frame).
